name: Dynamic tariff bundled with devices or smart metering
summary: A supplier sells hourly-priced electricity and bundles it with devices (smart meter bridge, wallbox, heat pump or battery installation) and an app that shifts consumption to cheap hours.
how_it_makes_money: Supply margin and service fees from the electricity contract; devices and installation are sold or discounted to win customers who can use dynamic prices.

hardware: Smart meter or meter reader bridge
Wallbox, battery or heat pump (optional bundle)
financing: Device subsidies funded from expected supply margin
channel: Direct digital sales, comparison, partner referrals

stakeholder_value.customer: Lower cost if load is shifted

what_must_be_true: Customers have a smart meter or a bridge device
Customers own loads they can shift
Supplier can price and hedge dynamic supply
Customer acquisition cost stays below lifetime margin

risks_failure_causes.text: Smart meter coverage gates how many customers can take the tariff
Customers carry month-to-month price variability, which can put off households
Customers without working connectivity or meters cannot be served

cases.note: Offers a bridge reader (Tibber Pulse) for digital meters so customers can use dynamic prices without a smart meter, and offers wallbox purchase with installation.
Some especially cheap smart tariffs are bundled with installation of a heat pump, battery or solar. Octopus, Tibber and Rabot started a smart meter initiative in Germany.
